title: Ostent
summary: OS'TENT, noun [Latin ostentum, from ostendo.] 1. Appearance; air; manner; mien. [Little used.] 2. Show; manifestation; token. [Little used.] 3. A prodigy; a portent; any thing ominous. [Little used.]
